items.title: Awakening Sleeping Beauties at The Met
items.summary: AI can enrich lives through beauty and creativity, and its artistic potential shines in "Sleeping Beauties: Reawakening Fashion," a collaborative exhibit from The Met's Costume Institute.

items.title: A failed experiment: Infini-Attention, and why we should keep trying?
items.summary: 来自原始信息源的最新动态，点击标题查看完整内容。
items.summaryZh: 失败的实验：无限注意力，为什么我们应该继续尝试？本文还有简体中文版。 TLDR：随着我们增加压缩内存的次数，Infini-attention 的性能会变得更差，据我们所知，环注意力、YaRN 和绳缩放仍然是将预训练模型扩展到更长上下文长度的最佳方法。
